title: combretum collinum subsp. elgonense
intro: Combretum collinum subsp. elgonense, commonly known as Elgon Combretum, is a plant species within the Combretaceae family. It has been used in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits, including the treatment of various ailments such as fever, wounds, and skin conditions. The plant is known for its therapeutic actions, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, making it effective in reducing pain and inflammation, fighting infections, and protecting against oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents of Combretum collinum subsp. elgonense include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
